get_tf_activation_by_name: get a TensorFlow activation function by name such as bentid, erf, atan, asinh, leaky_relu, gelu, or gelu_exact
get_transformed_activations: get a dictionary of transformed activation functions for DKS or TAT methods using TensorFlow
use_bentid_activation: use the bentid activation function which computes (sqrt(x^2+1)-1)/2 + x in TensorFlow
use_gelu_activation: use the gelu activation function with approximate or exact mode via the TensorFlow activation getter
use_standard_tf_activation: use any standard tf.nn activation function by name through the TensorFlow activation getter
